newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soybeans close higher on Pro Farmer forecast.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soybeans close higher on Pro Farmer forecast.

text.p: A Professional Farmers of America estimate of 1996 U.S. soybean production at between 2.08 billion and 2.1 billion bushels boosted CBOT soybean futures to a higher close, traders said.
"That's giving strength to the market," said Ron Kucha of O'Connor and Co.
USDA's August crop production estimate put the U.S. soybean crop this year at 2.3 billion bushels.
September gained on spreads on firm cash markets and exports. Taiwanese importers were expected in the market this week for 118,000 tonnes of U.S. soybeans.
Soybean futures volume was estimated at 49,000, up from 33,006 Friday, according to the CBOT.
In soybean options, Cargill Inc bought 500 November $7.25 puts at 6-1/2, they said. Smith Barney sold 900 November $7.00 and $7.50 put spreads at 11-1/2 cents, traders said.
Soybean options volume was estimated at 14,500, up from 13,083 Friday.
Soybeans closed six to 13-3/4 cents per bushel higher, with September up 13-3/4 at $8.17 a bushel. November was up 10-3/4 at $7.89-1/2.
